title: SKULL DEMON GRAPHIC OVERSIZED TEE
description: Constructed from custom-knitted 280 GSM heavy combed loopback cotton. Features an intricate 3-skull horned demon centerpiece artwork on the back executed in high-density stark white screen-printed ink, paired with a minimalist gothic 'aercious' chest insignia on the front. Cut with exaggerated dropped shoulders, dense 1.25-inch shape-retention collar ribbing, and a relaxed boxy drape.
materialDetails: 100% Premium Combed Cotton. Bio-washed and silicon-softened for a smooth hand-feel. Pre-shrunk fabric to preserve structural geometry wash after wash. Reinforced double-needle stitching along hem and cuffs.
howToChooseSize: Designed with an authentic oversized streetwear silhouette. Select your standard size to achieve the intended relaxed boxy drape with extended elbow-length sleeves. If you prefer a more tailored or standard fit, we recommend sizing down one size.
careInstructions: Machine wash cold inside-out with like colors. Use mild eco-friendly detergent. Do not bleach or tumble dry. Dry flat in shade. Do not iron directly on the graphic print; use low steam on reverse side.

reviews.author: Aarav Mehta
reviews.title: Insane 280 GSM weight. Architectural silhouette that doesn't collapse.
reviews.content: The weight on this cotton is crazy. You can immediately feel the 280 GSM heft when you pick up the box. It holds a stiff, structured boxy drape off the torso without clinging. The 1.25-inch thick ribbed collar is tight around the neck and hasn't loosened after 3 cold washes. Easily competes with international couture streetwear.

reviews.author: Devansh K.
reviews.title: Gothic demon back graphic is razor sharp.
reviews.content: The back artwork detail is unreal in person. It feels embedded into the heavyweight fibers rather than cheap plastisol that cracks. Sits right at the elbow and pairs beautifully with baggy black denim. Dispatched within 24 hours of ordering.

reviews.author: Siddharth Nair
reviews.title: Drop shoulder geometry done right.
reviews.content: Most brands in India simply increase the chest size and call it oversized. Aercious actually designed proper dropped shoulders with high armholes and a shortened body length so it doesn't look like a dress. Pure perfection.

reviews.author: Kabir Rao
reviews.title: Shape-retention collar really doesn't bacon.
reviews.content: I was skeptical about the zero-bacon collar claim because every heavy t-shirt I own gets wavy collars after wash 2. Wore this 5 times, washed on delicate cold, hung dry—collar is still razor straight. 10/10.

reviews.author: Neil D'Souza
reviews.title: Top-tier quality and unboxing experience.
reviews.content: The holographic seal and numbered archive card in the matte black packaging set a new standard. Note that 280 GSM is genuinely heavy cotton—best for air conditioned spaces or evening wear rather than mid-day heat. Stunning piece.

title: ACID WASH MINIMALIST LOGO TEE
description: Crafted from 260 GSM single jersey cotton subjected to a proprietary artisan mineral acid wash, ensuring that no two garments share the exact same marbled patina. Features a subtle high-definition gothic 'aercious' micro-logo centered cleanly on the chest. Designed with wide elbow sleeves and a structured architectural torso.
materialDetails: 100% Combed Compact Cotton with custom mineral stone acid wash. Pre-washed and enzyme treated for vintage broken-in softness without losing structural weight. Anti-curling collar binding.
howToChooseSize: This piece features a generous drop-shoulder streetwear cut. Take your typical t-shirt size for a signature modern oversized aesthetic that pairs naturally with wide-leg cargos or stacked raw selvedge denim.
careInstructions: Hand wash or gentle machine wash in cold water (max 30°C). Wash inside-out to protect the unique vintage mineral acid wash wash. Do not wring or dry clean. Line dry in shade. Warm iron on reverse.

reviews.author: Vikramaditya Sen
reviews.title: The mineral wash texture has genuine couture drape.
reviews.content: The stone wash marbling is so organic. You can tell this isn't printed pattern—it's genuine enzyme mineral washed fabric. Soft broken-in drape right out of the packaging with zero compromise on structural density. Stylist on WhatsApp gave perfect size advice.

reviews.author: Rohan Patel
reviews.title: Best vintage wash tee on the market.
reviews.content: Boxy shoulders, relaxed sleeves hitting right at the elbow, and zero shrinkage after delicate cycle. The minimal gothic branding on the chest is understated luxury at its finest.

reviews.author: Ananya Sharma
reviews.title: Unisex fit is flawless.
reviews.content: Styled this with tailored wide-leg trousers and chunky sneakers. The fabric falls cleanly away from the body without billowing. Got at least three compliments on the first day out in Bandra.

reviews.author: Farhan Qureshi
reviews.title: Dense knit and exceptional finish.
reviews.content: Exceeded all expectations. The collar ribbing is super sturdy and the colorway matches everything from raw denim to cargo pants. 10% prepaid discount was applied seamlessly.
